messages:
Rae (partners_pm): quick idea  run a 2-day 'labshot' for two systems integrators to get marketplace-ready + a lightweight Verified badge. Targets: marketplace listing checklist, a demo GIF, and a short cert. Can we do week after next?
Liam (partner_eng): yes. infra notes: ephemeral API keys, quota 80k tokens/day for each SI, allowlist lab runner IPs. Will provide a `sample-access.yml`.
Jo (partner_ops): vouchers check: 2 remaining HW vouchers; will allocate if partners confirm by Tue COB. Enrollment form link will be posted.
Ana (enablement): cert format: 25-min practical (deploy + smoke test) + 10 MCQs. pass=78%. practical auto-checked by smoke script plus one human review.
Marta (marketing): co-marketing: propose a joint announcement after badges issued. Need partner logos, 2-sentence blurb, and a 15s GIF. I can make the landing copy + webinar page.
onboard-bot: reminder  create partner enrollment form in /ops/forms by 3647773600
Liam (partner_eng): I'll push the lab starter (tiny Node app + Docker) and a `ci/record-demo.yml` to produce a 15s GIF. ETA: Thurs EOD.
Jo (partner_ops): enrollment form posted: https://go.redwood/forms/si-labshot. Added voucher opt-in and preferred timezone.
Ana (enablement): I'll write the MCQs and practical rubric. Recommend one retake after 48h.
Rae (partners_pm): owners: Liam -> infra + starter repo, Jo -> vouchers & enrollment, Ana -> cert + rubric, Marta -> promo + announcement. I'll schedule invites and create project board. Sync Fri 9am to finalize assets. :white_check_mark:
